title: Control Center
summary: A MEE6-inspired dashboard architecture replaces oversized decorative layouts with a compact module directory, clearer navigation, denser settings surfaces and consistent light/dark control-center styling while preserving BOM functionality and branding.

sections.title: Dashboard architecture
items: Rebuilt the dashboard home around a compact server overview and filterable module directory instead of a large decorative hero.
Added All Modules, Operations, World of Sea Battles, Community and Administration filters with consistent module cards and direct Open actions.
Retained favorites, recently viewed items, notifications and recent listening while presenting them as compact control-center activity panels.
Preserved existing dashboard home visibility preferences; the previous Quick Access preference now controls the new module directory.

sections.title: Navigation and visual system
items: Added a compact current-server block and tightened the desktop sidebar around grouped bot modules.
Refined the top bar, search, create, notification, favorite, appearance and account controls into one consistent utility row.
Replaced near-black/olive surfaces with neutral charcoal/slate dark mode and a clean neutral light mode while keeping BOM gold for active and primary actions.
Removed decorative glow and large-gradient treatments from core workspace surfaces.

sections.title: Settings and tools
items: Normalized cards, tabs, inputs, selects, forms, modals, tables and status treatments across Admin, Sentinel, Music, Automations, Branding, Ship Builder, Prep & Review, Wiki, Map and Port Battles.
Administration keeps Basic, Advanced and Diagnostics behavior but now reads as a compact settings console.
Legacy feature panels retain their existing logic while old dark/green visual styling is neutralized by the new shared design system.
Map, Wiki and WoSB workspaces keep their current data, natural-language features and interactions.

sections.title: Functionality preservation
items: No API routes, database migrations, Discord controller logic, music workers, Port Battle behavior, Sentinel queries or Wiki knowledge logic were changed.
No new runtime dependency is required; the existing dependency-free Lucide-style icon component remains in use.
Light/dark appearance, compact sidebar, command palette, notification center, inspector, mobile dock and unsaved-change protection remain available.
